## §W4-2. INV11-W4-2

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "INV11-W4-2-RHO-VAC-Q-T-SURFACE"
schema_version: "R3"
gate_type: "compute"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "PHONONIC"

hypothesis: "ρ_vac(q,T) extracted from the 992 D_K fold eigenfrequencies — generalizing the S97-W2-2 / S101-W1 present-epoch curvature k=+3586.53 M_KK (the q-theory zero-point + condensate response, exponent→2 from below) to a full vacuum-energy-vs-temperature surface across T=0→T_BBN→T_transit — converts the C10 tracking ANSATZ (ρ_vac∝H², assumed) into a DERIVATION, and thereby adjudicates whether the BBN excess (ρ_vac/ρ_rad=0.474 at T_BBN) is a real substrate feature or an artifact of extrapolating the present-epoch quadratic form across 30 decades of temperature."

method:
  description: >
    Build ε(q,T) directly from the substrate spectrum. The q-theory vacuum energy is
    ρ_vac(q) = ε(q) − q·dε/dq (Volovik Paper #13 Eq.4 / Paper #25 Eq.2.11), with q the conserved
    vacuum charge (q = N_pair, the substrate's 4-form/elasticity-tetrad variable). At finite T,
    ε(q,T) = Σ_n ½ω_n(q)·coth(ω_n(q)/2T) over the 992 fold eigenfrequencies ω_n(q)=√(λ_n²+q)
    (the q-deformed dispersion, S97-W2-2 boundary q_boundary=−0.67197549). Compute the surface
    over a (q,T) grid spanning q near 0 (present epoch) out to the transit value and T from 0
    through T_BBN to T_fold. Extract: (i) the curvature d²ε/dq²|₀ at each T (verify it reproduces
    k_curv=+3586.53 at T→0, the S97-W2-2 / S101-W1 present-epoch anchor); (ii) the effective
```

```yaml
    (the First-Law paper) — verify against the corpus which paper(s) establish H/π and confirm

    horizon co-tunneling → H/2π; Volovik #15 §II Eq.5 and #35 §III.B state this explicitly). (4)
    Verdict: for the GGE-relic rate and for the de Sitter decay rate (W4-3's input), state which
    T is currently used, which T is PHYSICALLY CORRECT, and which Boltzmann factors are
    consequently off by a square. Emit a verdict line + WP section.
  producing_script: "computations/investigation-11/inv11_w4_gh_t_convention_audit.py"   # a trace/audit script; greps the rate scripts, tabulates T usage, prints the verdict payload

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    CLAIM: "Every exp(−E/T) Boltzmann factor that uses the wrong de Sitter temperature is off by
            a SQUARE."

    Definition 1: T_GH       = horizon Gibbons-Hawking temperature = H/(2π) [H-BH-6; Volovik #07]
    Definition 2: T_local    = local bulk de Sitter temperature = H/π = 2·T_GH [Volovik #15 Eq.5; #35 §III.B]
    Definition 3: B(T)       = Boltzmann factor of a rate = exp(−E/T) for excitation energy E

    Substitute (the factor the two conventions differ by, inside one Boltzmann factor):
        B(T_local) / B(T_GH) = exp(−E/T_local) / exp(−E/T_GH)
                              = exp(−E/(H/π)) / exp(−E/(H/(2π)))
                              = exp(−Eπ/H) / exp(−2Eπ/H)

    Simplify (one algebra step):
        = exp(−Eπ/H + 2Eπ/H)
        = exp(+Eπ/H)
        = [exp(−Eπ/H)]^{−1}                    [reciprocal]
      Equivalently, writing x ≡ exp(−E/T_GH) = exp(−2Eπ/H):
        B(T_GH)    = x
        B(T_local) = exp(−Eπ/H) = x^{1/2}       [since x = (x^{1/2})^2 = exp(−2Eπ/H)]

    Canonical form: B(T_GH) = [B(T_local)]^2   (the horizon-T Boltzmann factor is the SQUARE of
                    the local-T Boltzmann factor — equivalently, using T_GH where T_local is
                    correct squares the suppression; using T_local where T_GH is correct
                    square-roots it).

    Direction: a factor-2 in T inside exp(−E/T) is a factor-2 in the exponent argument, hence a
               SQUARE (or square-root) in the Boltzmann factor — exactly the claim.

    Conclusion: "wrong T ⇒ off by a square" is exact (no tolerance). The audit's job is therefore
                NOT to verify this algebra (it is proven here) but to determine, per rate, WHICH T
                is used and which is correct — so the squared error is caught wherever it lives.
                This is why the audit MUST precede W4-3: W4-3's Γ_dS~exp(−2m/T) inherits the square.
```

## Wave 4 → Wave 5 / Session-Promotion Decision Point

Wave 4 has no downstream Wave-5 consumer inside the per-wave plan (W5 is the neutral-planned cross-agent wave: the M_KK adjudication W5-1 + the compact-object interior W5-2, neither of which consumes W4 outputs). The W4 verdicts route to SESSION-PROMOTION at `/rclab-investigate --investigation 11` close:

- **W4-1 PASS** (BBN relieved + Ω landed) → routes HY5 (atlas-04 C10 re-tag) toward "CONFIRMED-PRESENT-EPOCH / BBN-RELIEVED-BY-TWO-FLUID-EXCHANGE" (designated writer; the verdict supplies the relieved BBN fraction); the dark-sector reconciliation (Leggett w=0 + stiff w=1 coexisting) feeds a registry note on C-V1.
- **W4-1 FAIL** (BBN stays >0.227) → HY5 confirms "BBN-FALSIFIED-AT-2×" stands; the BBN wound routes forward to a distinct mechanism (inv-8 running-vacuum-RG), pre-registered as a next-investigation carry-forward.
- **W4-2 INFO** (n(T) departs) → the C10 ansatz's domain-of-validity becomes the registry note; W4-1's effective BBN target is revised to the artifact-corrected real excess.
- **W4-3 PASS** (w_a<0, DESI-favored, σ improves) → a NEW falsifier-inventory w_a row (mack sole-writer, session-promotion) pre-registering the de Sitter-instability w_a<0 prediction against DESI DR3 (~2027, σ_w0~0.035–0.046); atlas-04 C5 gains a "de Sitter-instability candidate mechanism" cross-ref (status STAYS BROKEN — prediction-vs-data unchanged until DR3, but the mechanism is now named).
- **W4-3 FAIL** (w_a≥0) → the frozen-modulus triple-lock reading survives; C5 stays BROKEN with no new mechanism; the de Sitter-decay corridor is closed.
- **W4-4 FAIL** (corpus T-ambiguity) → BLOCKS W4-3 (mechanical-closure PRE-REG-INC); routes a source-fidelity workshop carry-forward (read the primary Volovik de Sitter derivations) ahead of any de Sitter-rate compute.

All session-track edits (atlas-04 cells, falsifier-inventory rows, canonical_constants pins) are made by their designated sole-writers at session-promotion — NEVER as in-investigation edits (track-local boundary).
